name: Suspicious LSASS Process Access
description: Detects processes opening LSASS memory with rights used by credential dumping tools.
query: any where event.code == "10" and winlog.event_data.TargetImage : "*\\lsass.exe" and winlog.event_data.GrantedAccess : ("0x1010", "0x1410", "0x1fffff")
false_positives: Endpoint protection agents that read LSASS
author: Ashgrove Detection Engineering
